April 20, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc increased its stake in Canadian Nat Res Ltd (CNQ) by 15.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc bought 29,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.77% with the market. The institutional investor held 215,770 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.71 million, up from 186,070 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Canadian Nat Res Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $41.50B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.33% or $0.84   $35.18. About 2.02 million shares traded. Canadian Natural Resources Limited (NYSE:CNQ) has declined 3.31%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.86% the S&P500. 
Alex Denner increased its stake in Achillion Pharmaceuticals Inc (ACHN) by 17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sarissa Capital Management Lp bought 363,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 28.04% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Alex Denner held 2.50 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.20M, up from 2.14M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sarissa Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Achillion Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $502.62 million market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.01   $3.64. About 305,354 shares traded. Achillion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:ACHN) has declined 2.57%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.12% the S&P500. 
Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc, which manages about $304.23M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in General Dynamics Corp (NYSE:GD) by 1,655 shares to 14,855 shares, valued at $3.02M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,272 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 55,860 shares, and cut its stake in Agrium Inc (NYSE:AGU).
